LifeLinkQR Administrator Control Centre V1

Added:
- Dedicated administrator control centre.
- Administrator identity checked against admins/{uid}.
- Professional account list.
- Filters: all, pending, approved, rejected, suspended.
- Approve, reject, suspend and reactivate controls.
- Summary counts.
- No Firestore security rules were weakened.

IMPORTANT:
The existing Firestore rule currently allows admin users to update users/{uid}. If an account is suspended through this portal, scanner access is blocked by the scannerIsApproved() rule because accountStatus is no longer active.

Test:
1. Sign in with the configured admin account.
2. Open admin-control-centre.html.
3. Approve a pending professional.
4. Confirm the professional can scan.
5. Suspend the same professional.
6. Confirm scanning is blocked.
7. Reactivate and confirm scanning works again.
